corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: Belgium and the European Commission are the substantive authors of their respective statements; the General Secretariat sends the wrapper and the Council is publisher, not sole substantive author. The OP English-labelled manifestation is mixed EN/FR, whereas the current Council /en/pdf is a fully English translation. Publication on 22 June 2026 is tied to the exact OP ADD 1 manifestation and is not a claim that the English translation first appeared that day.
